_typeNotation: Mini notation: 'string' 'int' 'bool' 'number' 'json'; 'T?' optional; '[T]' list; '{k:T}' object; 'A|B' enum/union; named types are in 'types'. Codegen converts to JSON Schema, Kotlin and Python stubs.

types.UiSnapshot: {ts:int, package:string?, activity:string?, keyboard:'visible|hidden', nodes:[NodeSummary]?, compact:string?, nodeCount:int, empty:bool, path:string?}  # meta.degraded when served from cache

capabilities.summary: Observe and act on other apps' UI through the best available provider (accessibility; shell as fallback).

methods.name: snapshot
methods.description: Read the UI tree (hardened: ReadGate, guards).

methods.name: click
methods.description: Fail closed on stale/obscured targets.

methods.name: set_text
methods.description: Strategy chain: SET_TEXT → IME → paste → shell.

capabilities.summary: Capture the screen (fallback chain: accessibility API 30+ → MediaProjection → shell).
Query, launch and stop apps.

methods.name: launch
methods.description: Verify the foreground package after launch; blocked background starts are silent.

capabilities.summary: Screen/keyguard state (control methods arrive in W2).
Reliable text entry and background clipboard through the AutoHost keyboard.
Post a notification (with actions/progress).
Ask the user something while a run waits (WAITING_USER).
Task-private storage.
Brokered HTTP with domain allowlist and size caps.
Persistent key-value stores (profile- and task-scoped). Non-secret values only.
Read declared secret fields of the active profile (host injects at call time).

methods.name: get
methods.description: Value is registered with the redactor; never log it.

capabilities.summary: Checkpoints and stage records owned by the host.
Read, react to, press and dismiss other apps' notifications through the notification listener.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Active notifications visible in the grant scope.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Full text of one notification.

methods.name: press
methods.description: Tap one of the notification's action buttons (sent, not verified).

methods.name: dismiss_all
methods.description: Dismiss every dismissible notification in scope.

methods.name: wait_for
methods.description: Block until a matching notification appears (P8-01).

capabilities.summary: Read (focus-gated) and set the system clipboard; background reads go through the IME.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Focused reads only on Android 10+; CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE with an honest hint otherwise.

capabilities.summary: Start activities and broadcasts behind an allowlist carried by the grant.

methods.name: open_settings
methods.description: page in {wifi,bluetooth,display,sound,applications,battery,date,locale,input,accessibility,notification_listener,exact_alarms,app_details,settings}.

methods.name: start_activity
methods.description: Explicit actions/packages must be granted; http(s) VIEW is the built-in exception.

methods.name: broadcast
methods.description: Action must be in the grant's actions scope.

capabilities.summary: Read-side window into the host EventHub ring buffer; reactive use is via trigger rules.

methods.name: recent
methods.description: The last events the hub observed (buffer 200). Live delivery is trigger rules (§11.9).

capabilities.summary: User-picked folders (SAF) and MediaStore reads/writes. Trees must be granted; media ops need the media scope flag plus the storage permission (lazy).

methods.name: list
methods.description: Children of a path inside a granted tree.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Read a document (5 MB cap, truncated honestly).

methods.name: write
methods.description: Create/overwrite a document inside a granted tree.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Delete a document inside a granted tree.

methods.name: media_list
methods.description: Newest MediaStore rows for a media type.

methods.name: media_read
methods.description: Read a MediaStore row's bytes (5 MB cap).

methods.name: media_write
methods.description: Insert a new MediaStore row (own contribution; pending->ready).

methods.name: media_delete
methods.description: Delete a MediaStore row (may surface a system confirm on some OEMs).

capabilities.summary: Outbound WebSocket client (RFC 6455) with size/time caps and the net.http domain allowlist.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Open a ws:// or wss:// connection (origin + subprotocols optional).

methods.name: send
methods.description: Send a text frame.

methods.name: recv
methods.description: Wait for one frame (poll with deadline; server pings answered internally).

methods.name: close
methods.description: Close the connection.

capabilities.summary: Local webhook endpoint: POST /hook/<name> fires the matching `external` trigger. Localhost by default; LAN opt-in with token.

methods.name: status
methods.description: Whether the webhook server is running, port and binding.

methods.name: hook_names
methods.description: Names of installed `external` trigger rules (what a webhook can fire).

capabilities.summary: Volume, ringer, DND status (honest), TTS, vibrate, flashlight. DND changes need policy access (setup action).

methods.name: volume
methods.description: Read (or set with level 0-100) a stream volume.

methods.name: ringer
methods.description: Ringer mode read; set to normal/silent/vibrate where the device allows.

methods.name: dnd
methods.description: Do-not-disturb state (read-only in v1; changes need notification-policy access).

methods.name: speak
methods.description: TTS the text (default engine, best effort; result is queued not verified).

methods.name: vibrate
methods.description: Vibrate for a duration.

methods.name: flashlight
methods.description: Torch on/off; unavailable when the camera is in use.

methods.name: play_sound
methods.description: Play a short built-in tone (best effort).

capabilities.summary: Battery/charging state, task-scoped wake lock and keep-awake. Never changes device-level battery settings.

methods.name: battery
methods.description: Battery level, charging state and plug type.

methods.name: wake_lock
methods.description: Acquire (or release) the task-scoped PARTIAL_WAKE_LOCK; auto-released at run end.

methods.name: keep_awake
methods.description: Keep the screen on for this run (best effort; pre-flight ScreenGuard still applies).

capabilities.summary: Floating overlays a run can draw: highlight boxes, text panels, status strips. Visible and stoppable; needs the accessibility overlay.

methods.name: highlight
methods.description: Draw a highlight rectangle (absolute pixels) for a duration.

methods.name: panel
methods.description: Show a small text panel (run progress) until cleared or the run ends.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Remove this run's overlays.

capabilities.summary: Read system/secure/global settings tables; write via the one-time WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS grant or the paired shell tier (W4, gated).
androidAccess: WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS (one-time `adb shell pm grant`, optional) OR the paired shell tier

methods.name: read
methods.description: Read one setting by table and key (string value; null when absent).

methods.name: read_many
methods.description: Read several keys from one table in one call.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Write one setting (ADR-067). Protected keys (accessibility/IME self-heal ownership, provisioning) are always refused; secure/global writes need confirm:true. Verified by read-back.

capabilities.summary: Script-proposed next-run adjustments within declared bounds (ctx.next_run). Proposals are user-visible and clamped.
Start another task/profile and await its result (chaining). Depth/cycle limited; counts toward locks.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Run a task (optionally with a profile) and wait for its terminal status.

capabilities.summary: Raw Android API access from Python (Chaquopy jclass / system services). Breaks the sandbox by design; needs the android.api.direct grant AND the raw_api switch.

methods.name: authorize
methods.description: Handshake: confirms the grant + raw_api switch and returns a session marker for the worker.

capabilities.summary: Run allowlisted shell commands through the paired shell tier (ADB-over-TCP, wireless debugging, Shizuku or root). DANGEROUS; allowlist default empty; needs the device.shell grant AND the shell switch.
androidAccess: SHELL TIER (adb-over-tcp pairing, wireless-debugging pairing, Shizuku server or root)

methods.name: run
methods.description: Execute one allowlisted command. Shell metacharacters (; & | ` ( ) < > and $) are always refused (ADR-066); the command must match a pattern in the grant's commands list.

methods.name: transports
methods.description: Status of every configured shell transport (live / awaiting_authorization / needs_setup / unsupported).

capabilities.summary: Install/uninstall APK, clear app data, grant/revoke runtime permissions, verified force-stop. T3 shell tier; DANGEROUS; needs the device.app.manage grant AND the app_manage switch. Destructive methods demand confirm:true.
androidAccess: SHELL TIER (pm/am through adb-over-tcp, wireless debugging, Shizuku or root); installer-UI mode uses the accessibility service + the auto-accept gate

methods.name: force_stop
methods.description: Verified force-stop chain: `am force-stop` over the shell tier first (real exit code, VERIFIED), then the App-info UI path, then killBackgroundProcesses (BEST_EFFORT/FAILED honestly).

methods.name: clear_state
methods.description: `pm clear <pkg>` — destroys the app's data. Needs confirm:true; VERIFIED on exit 0 with a Success line.

methods.name: grant_permission
methods.description: `pm grant <pkg> <permission>` — runtime permission grant via the shell uid. Applied on exit 0; no readback claim (verified:false).

methods.name: revoke_permission
methods.description: `pm revoke <pkg> <permission>` — the revoke twin of grant_permission.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Install an APK. mode pm: `cat <path> | pm install -S <bytes>` over the shell tier (VERIFIED on Success). mode installer: ACTION_VIEW through FileProvider with the a11y auto-accept gate tapping the known installer buttons; outcomes are honest UI-chain results (CONFIRMED = the installer window appeared and left; WAITING_USER = nothing we recognize appeared in time) — never a package readback.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: `pm uninstall <pkg>` — needs confirm:true; NOT_FOUND when the package is absent.

capabilities.summary: Snapshot/clear the logcat main buffer for evidence. T3 shell tier; dev-grade; needs the device.logcat grant AND the logcat switch. A package filter resolves the app's pid via pidof — no package claims without it.

methods.name: snapshot
methods.description: Bounded `logcat -d -v epoch -t N` dump (device-side tag filter; level/pid/text filters applied at parse; since_ms bounds the window).
methods.returns: {lines:[{ts:int?, level:string, tag:string, pid:int?, message:string}], count:int, parsed:int, package:string?}

methods.name: clear
methods.description: `logcat -c` — clears the main buffer.

capabilities.summary: Wi-Fi / Bluetooth / airplane / mobile-data toggles through the shell tier (`svc`, settings + broadcast). T3 only — Wi-Fi toggling is blocked for normal apps since API 29; Bluetooth toggling works only up to API 32. Acts report the exit code honestly; no readback claim (verified:false).

methods.name: set
methods.description: Toggle one radio. airplane runs the two-step global write + the connectivity broadcast.

capabilities.summary: Dark mode, orientation and font scale through the shell tier (`cmd uimode night`, `settings put`). T3.

methods.name: set_dark_mode
methods.description: `cmd uimode night yes|no|auto`.

methods.name: set_orientation
methods.description: Lock the orientation (accelerometer_rotation off + user_rotation) or re-enable auto-rotate.

methods.name: set_font_scale
methods.description: `settings put system font_scale <v>` (0.5..2.0 sane window).

capabilities.summary: The mock-location appop for AutoHost itself (DANGEROUS; needs the device.location.mock grant AND the mock_location switch). Verified against `appops get` — the readback is real.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Allow or deny the mock-location appop for app.autohost (the only targetable package).

capabilities.summary: Automate pages in a visible in-app WebView (Playwright-like subset): open/navigate/click/type/extract/cookies. Real input events where the WebView allows; challenges are detected and routed to WAITING_USER — never bypassed. Per-profile cookie isolation (S26).

scope.domains: [string] (glob patterns like net.http; empty = deny all)

androidAccess: in-app WebView (always available; the visible surface is user-stoppable)

methods.name: open
methods.description: Open a page in the visible in-app browser. URL is http(s) (domain-allowlisted) or task:<relpath> (a file inside this task's own bundle). Result carries challenge:{kind,matched} when an anti-bot wall is detected.

params.challenge: 'raise' (default; SDK pauses the run) | 'report' (return the dict)

methods.returns: {page_id:string, url:string, title:string?, load_state:string, profile:string, input_mode:'real'|'synthetic', challenge?:{kind:string, matched:string}}

methods.name: navigate
methods.description: Navigate an open page to a new URL (same policy as open).
methods.returns: {page_id, url, title?, load_state, profile, input_mode, challenge?}

methods.name: click
methods.description: Click a CSS selector: the element's box is resolved and a real MotionEvent stream is injected (input_mode 'real'); old WebViews fall back to JS dispatch reported honestly as 'synthetic' (S25).

methods.name: type
methods.description: Click the selector then type: ASCII goes as real key events (KeyCharacterMap); anything else falls back to a JS value-set reported as input_mode 'synthetic'. The text is never echoed back.

methods.name: extract
methods.description: Extract text/attribute values for all elements matching a CSS selector (capped).

methods.name: cookies
methods.description: Cookies of the page's profile jar (per-profile isolated, S26).

methods.name: clear_cookies
methods.description: Clear the page's profile cookie jar.

methods.name: pages
methods.description: All pages of this run (max 4).

methods.name: close
methods.description: Close one page (its visible surface finishes).

capabilities.summary: Drive the user's own browser app through the accessibility layer: open (VIEW intent + foreground wait), click by visible text, type into the focused field, extract the visible text. No cookies, no CSS — the DOM is not exposed; those limits are enforced, not worked around.
androidAccess: ACCESSIBILITY SERVICE (T1) — the AutoHost accessibility service must be enabled

methods.name: open
methods.description: ACTION_VIEW the URL in the user's browser and wait for a foreground browser. http(s) only (allowlisted); challenge detection runs on the visible text.

methods.name: click
methods.description: Click a node whose text (or content-desc) contains the selector (case-insensitive), through the a11y click chain.

methods.name: type
methods.description: Set text on the focused/first-editable field via the a11y text action (input_mode 'a11y').

methods.name: extract
methods.description: Visible text of the page as lines (a11y snapshot; only what is on screen).

methods.name: page
methods.description: The browser package plus the visible-text sample (challenge scan included).

methods.name: close
methods.description: Press back through the a11y global action (the user's browser stays theirs).

capabilities.summary:
Chrome DevTools Protocol over the paired shell tier: `adb forward tcp:

localabstract:` through the shell transport, then a local WebSocket to the devtools endpoint. DRAFT — UNVERIFIED-on-hardware until spike S27 measures the route. Needs the shell tier.
androidAccess: SHELL TIER (adb forward through the paired transport) + WebView/Chrome debugging enabled

methods.name: status
methods.description: Route status: shell liveness and the honest draft verdict (verified_on_hardware:false until S27).

methods.name: navigate
methods.description: Page.navigate via CDP; title/visible sample scanned for challenges; URL allowlist still applies.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Runtime.evaluate with returnByValue (the CDP escape hatch; still grant-scoped by the shell tier).

methods.name: screenshot
methods.description: Page.captureScreenshot (PNG, base64).

methods.name: cookies
methods.description: Network.getCookies of the debugged target.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Page.close + the adb forward removed (run-terminal teardown also does this).

capabilities.summary: OCR, template match and QR decode over a screenshot region or a run-scoped image. Tier T4 contract on the wire: every result carries hint:true — hints, not proof. OCR text is never auto-evidenced (may contain secrets).
androidAccess: T4 engines over the screenshot provider chain (a11y API 30+ → projection → shell)

methods.name: ocr
methods.description: Recognize text (ML Kit Latin, bundled) in the current screen or an image file, optionally clipped to a region.
methods.returns: {hint:true, engine:string, source:string, width:int, height:int, duration_ms:int, lines:[{text, confidence?, box?}]}

methods.name: template_match
methods.description: Zero-mean NCC of a needle image over the source (pure, dependency-free; coarse stride + refine). Not rotation/scale invariant — documented hint semantics.
methods.returns: {hint:true, found:bool, score:double, box:{left,top,width,height}, threshold:double, stride:int, source:string, duration_ms:int}

methods.name: qr_decode
methods.description: Decode a QR code (ZXing core, bundled) from the screen or an image file.

capabilities.summary: Query and insert contacts (row-capped, name/phone/email fields). Lazy runtime permissions via the FixHub ask.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Query contacts by optional name filter (contains), capped.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Insert a contact (name required; phone/email optional).

capabilities.summary: Query and insert calendar events in a bounded window (31 days max). Lazy runtime permissions.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Events overlapping [from_ms, to_ms] (defaults: now -> +7 days; window <= 31 days).

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Insert an event into the primary writable calendar.

capabilities.summary: Device-wide MediaStore rows (images/video/audio) — distinct from files.shared's user-picked-tree media ops. Byte-capped reads/inserts.

methods.name: list
methods.description: List media rows (newest first), optionally per kind.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Read one media item as base64 (10 MB cap).

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Insert bytes (base64) as an image/video/audio item (10 MB cap).

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Delete a media row.

capabilities.summary: One-shot location fixes (last-known marked stale; current waits up to 60 s). Background runs need 'Allow all the time' — honestly reported, never silently downgraded.
androidAccess: ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION / ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION (lazy); ACCESS_BACKGROUND_LOCATION for last_known in background runs

methods.name: last_known
methods.description: The most recent cached fix across providers (stale:true). Background runs need 'Allow all the time'.

methods.name: current
methods.description: One fresh fix within the timeout (falls back to last-known with stale:true).

capabilities.summary: One-shot photo capture (front or back camera) into a run-scoped file. No preview, no stealth — the shutter is visible.

methods.name: capture_photo
methods.description: Capture one JPEG.

capabilities.summary: Duration-capped audio recording (max 60 s, default 10 s) into a run-scoped file. The recording indicator stays on.

methods.name: record
methods.description: Record AAC audio for duration_ms (500..60000).

capabilities.summary: One-shot sensor reads (no permission, no continuous streams). list = what the device has; read = latest sample per sensor (bounded set).
androidAccess: none (sensor data needs no runtime permission)

methods.name: list
methods.description: All sensors with vendor/type.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Latest sample for the named sensors (all when omitted).

capabilities.summary: Read the inbox (sender-scoped by the grant), send with premium/short-code rails and a per-run budget, wait_for a matching message. DANGEROUS; full flavor only; needs the device.sms grant AND the sms switch. Delivery receipts are never claimed.
androidAccess: SEND_SMS / READ_SMS (full flavor manifest only) — lazily requested

methods.name: read_inbox
methods.description: Newest messages, optional contains-filter, scoped to the grant's senders list.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Send one SMS (<=480 chars, <=3 parts; premium destinations and short codes refused).

methods.name: wait_for
methods.description: Poll the inbox for a match within the timeout.

capabilities.summary: Call state read and dialer-owned calls (ACTION_CALL — the user sees and can cancel the dialer). DANGEROUS; full flavor only; needs the grant AND the telephony switch; premium/short-code rails like device.sms.
androidAccess: READ_PHONE_STATE (state) / CALL_PHONE (place_call) — full flavor manifest only

methods.name: call_state
methods.description: idle|ringing|offhook (+ the ringing number when known).

methods.name: place_call
methods.description: ACTION_CALL through the dialer (verified:false — the dialer owns the call).

capabilities.summary: Raw TCP client + one-shot UDP send/recv with the net.http-style domain allowlist, byte caps and run-scoped handles. Tasks initiate; listeners stay net.server's job.

methods.name: tcp_connect
methods.description: Open a TCP connection (<=8 handles per run).

methods.name: tcp_send
methods.description: Send base64 bytes (5 MB cap).

methods.name: tcp_recv
methods.description: Receive up to max_bytes within the timeout.

methods.name: tcp_close
methods.description: Close one handle.

methods.name: udp_send
methods.description: One-shot datagram (<=65527 bytes).

methods.name: udp_recv
methods.description: Bounded recv on an ephemeral local port.

capabilities.summary: The device dials OUT to a control/reporting host (plan 6.5): nothing listens on the device. Token rides the first frame (never the URL); plain ws:// only for localhost, wss:// otherwise. Off by default: needs the net.reverse grant AND the net_reverse switch.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Open the outbound WS; the token is sent as the first frame by the SDK.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Send one text frame (5 MB cap).

methods.name: recv
methods.description: One frame or closed.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Close the handle.
